messages.subject: Re: Two density plots and a couple of markers...
parts:
Is this what you had in mind?

library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)

janFeb.melt<-melt(janFeb)
ggplot(janFeb.melt, aes(x = value)) +
geom_density(fill = "darkorange", color = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
geom_hline(yintercept = 0.06, linetype = "dashed") +
labs(x = "x", y = "Density") +
facet_wrap(~ variable, ncol = 1)

I like a little color in my kernel densities :) Feel free to edit the
code to your tastes.

BTW, the on-line ggplot2 help pages can be found at
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/ , where you can find plenty of
illustrative examples.

Dennis

parts:
ggplot(janFeb.melt, aes(x = value)) +
geom_density(fill = "darkorange", color = NA, alpha = 0.5) +

To enable a different line in each facet, you need to create a data
frame that contains the desired intercepts and the corresponding
values of the facets. The last example in
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/geom_vline.html provides another
illustration.

Dennis
